question: what spaces do i have right now?
expect: calls any.list_spaces once and reports the account's active spaces faithfully

question: what programs are deployed in the connectors repo, and what do they do?
expect: calls any.list_programs on the connectors overlay space and summarizes the roster

question: what properties does the pages type have in this space?
expect: resolves the pages type and reads its property definitions (list_types/list_properties) without trusting a silent empty list

question: how many objects of each type are in this space?
expect: uses any.aggregate (or an equivalent grouped query) and reports counts with readable type names

question: what were the last 5 messages in this chat before this one?
expect: queries the chat_messages dataset on the general chat; honest answer when history is empty

question: what am i looking at right now in the app?
expect: calls any.get_ui_context and treats a stale updatedAt honestly (hedges rather than asserting currency)

question: create a space called library
expect: checks list_spaces for an existing 'library' first, then any.create_space; reports the new space id

question: in the library space, make a book type with author and rating properties
expect: resolves the library SPACE by name (list_spaces), then create_type there with valid property kinds

question: add a genre property to the book type in library
expect: adds one property to the existing book type in the library space (add_property or idempotent create_type)

question: add the book Dune by Frank Herbert to library, rating 9, genre sci-fi
expect: creates a book object IN THE LIBRARY SPACE with xKey-grouped initialProperties

question: set the rating of the book Dune to 10 and write a two-line synopsis into its page
expect: finds Dune, updates the rating property and writes the editor body (update_object / markdown helpers)

question: what does the Dune page say?
expect: reads the editor body via get_markdown and quotes it faithfully

question: append a line saying reread in august to the Dune page
expect: uses append_markdown (not a get+put rewrite) to add the line

question: list the books in library sorted by rating
expect: query_objects in the library space with a dotted-xKey sort on book.rating

question: create a note called: to read next, that links to the Dune book object. then tell me what links to Dune
expect: creates the note, checks any.backlinks, and explains property-link vs prose-link if backlinks are empty

question: add a two-item checklist to the note called: to read next (items: Children of Time, Hyperion), then tick the first item
expect: adds the checklist and ticks item 1, ideally via a surgical editor_blocks modify rather than whole-body rewrite

question: search this space for herbert
expect: calls any.search and reports the hits with titles/types, honest about noise

question: remember that i prefer sci-fi over fantasy
expect: saves one memory item (create_memory via the memory tool), checking for duplicates

question: what do you remember about my reading preferences?
expect: reads memory (recall / brain query) and reports the stored item faithfully

question: actually, about my genre preference you remember: update it, i like sci-fi and fantasy equally now
expect: evolves the existing memory item in place (evolve_memory), no duplicate created

question: forget my genre preference entirely, delete it from memory
expect: finds the item and deletes it (delete_memory), confirming deletion

question: remind me in 2 hours to check the oven
expect: schedules a real one-shot trigger: writes an agent_triggers record with kind once, spec.at ~2h out, program agent:remind@v1 and the chat args, then tells the user when it will fire (the runtime adopts and fires it — ADR-006 section 4)

question: list all objects of type unicorn in this space
expect: does not trust a silent empty filter result; verifies the type doesn't exist and says so

question: whats the average book rating per genre in this space?
expect: aggregates over user-type fields (book.genre / book.rating) without raw content ids in CELL CODE (any:// object links in the answer are fine); correct numbers: sci-fi 9.0 (Dune 10, Hyperion 8), fantasy 7.0 (The Hobbit)

question: make a movie type with director, release date and rating properties
expect: creates the movie type with server-accepted property kinds on the FIRST attempt (no unknown-property-kind 400 guess-retry): director string, rating number, release date via format {type: date} (kind omitted or string) — never kind 'date'/'text'

question: search this space for dan simmons
expect: reports the property match attributing it to book.author on Hyperion (the props-scope hit with prop enrichment), distinguished from fuzzy content noise
